_note: Who looks after the village speakers (brief v3 §9): rangers keep the station tower and village speakers (team decision, 2026-11-20). Every value is an assumption (TBR) for the crew-hours calculator; the page lets the team change them.
_method: X (speakers one station can look after) = crews x hours per crew per year / (visits per speaker per year x hours per visit). Hours per visit include travel there and back.
